answer_1.quote: We propose the task of Job Posting Generation (JPG) ... conditional generation given a job description and basic company information to generate a job requirement.
datasets: Real‑world Chinese job posting dataset (19 months, 2019‑2020)

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the performance of SAMA, we employ the following metrics: Word overlap based metrics... BLEU‑N and ROUGE‑N... Skill prediction metrics... Precision, Recall, and F1 value.

answer_4.quote: Three graduated student volunteers are asked to evaluate the generated paragraphs... Each generated paragraph is evaluated as bad (irrelevant skills or disfluent sentence), normal (basic relevant skills and fluent sentence), or good (rich and relevant skills and fluent sentence).
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators label each generated job requirement as bad, normal, or good based on relevance of skills and overall fluency.
